name: research_by_category
text:
[
  {
    "category": "scholarly",
    "description": "Academic works, papers, citations, DOIs, journals.",
    "providers": [
      "openalex",
      "crossref",
      "arxiv",
      "zenodo",
      "semanticscholar",
      "huggingface",
      "huggingface-papers"
    ],
    "default_provider": "openalex",
    "provider_kind": "adapter"
  },
  {
    "category": "legal",
    "description": "Case law, statutes, regulations, bills, government codes; ECHR/HUDOC, CJEU/CELEX and German case law (BVerfG, BGH, Rechtsprechung).",
    "providers": [
      "courtlistener",
      "ecfr",
      "federalregister",
      "oldp",
      "hudoc",
      "govinfo"
    ],
    "default_provider": "courtlistener",
    "provider_kind": "adapter"
  },
  {
    "category": "patent",
    "description": "Patents and prior art (USPTO, EPO, KIPO, JPO, CNIPA, DPMA; Lens aggregates WO/EP/DE/CN/US; Google Patents lookup is keyless). EPO/KIPRIS/PatentsView/Lens need keys; google-patents resolves publication numbers without one (free-text: site:patents.google.com web search).",
    "providers": [
      "epo",
      "kipris",
      "patentsview",
      "lens",
      "google-patents"
    ],
    "default_provider": "epo",
    "provider_kind": "adapter"
  },
  {
    "category": "financial",
    "description": "Stock quotes, market data, exchange rates, indices; ECB/Eurozone rates and EU macro statistics (Bundesbank, Eurostat, HICP, Euribor).",
    "providers": [
      "yahoo",
      "frankfurter",
      "eurostat",
      "bundesbank",
      "bis",
      "coingecko",
      "alphavantage"
    ],
    "default_provider": "yahoo",
    "provider_kind": "adapter"
  },
  {
    "category": "geo",
    "description": "Weather, climate, coordinates and place lookups.",
    "providers": [
      "open-meteo",
      "overpass"
    ],
    "default_provider": "open-meteo",
    "provider_kind": "adapter"
  },
  {
    "category": "general",
    "description": "General web search (fallback when no domain matches).",
    "providers": [
      "duckduckgo"
    ],
    "default_provider": "duckduckgo",
    "provider_kind": "engine"
  }
]
